notes: Tetragon captured the sched_process_exec telemetry for /bin/cat and, under the ebpf-lab-file-access tracing policy, recorded a sys_openat event whose pathname argument is /etc/shadow. Pathname-specific visibility of the sensitive-file open is therefore established at the telemetry level. This is kernel/event visibility only: no alerting policy evaluated the open as a security detection, so this is telemetry observed, not a confirmed detection.
